items.summary: Compute-scaled DAgger warm-start sweep at fixed hidden=64/depth=2 to test the 'compute-starved, not capacity-starved' hypothesis. 3x games (90) and 3x epochs (75) over item17-2026-05-11 take-2 baseline, same teacher (rollout-CRN x3), same KL anchor schedule (0.0/0.1/0.5). Pre-registered exit: iter-2 Wilson lower >= 0.45 at n>=500 side-balanced. Distinct from R3 (entropy axis), R4 (value-head axis), R6 (capacity axis) — this run isolates the SL-compute axis at fixed capacity.
